omen: 岸上的脚印正朝海里退。
outcomes: [{"id":"spit","weight":2,"requires":{},"updates":{"crew.location":"shore","boat.afloat":false,"boat.cargo":0},"goal":{"crew.location":"shore"},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"海把人吐到了岸上，连衣服都是干的。船不见了。","tradeoff":"船和货物沉没。"},{"id":"shore","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"boat.location":"reef","crew.location":"seabed","crew.gills":true,"crew.webbed":true,"crew.shore_changed":true,"crew.can_sleep":false,"boat.afloat":false,"boat.cargo":0},"goal":{"crew.location":"shore"},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"crew.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他们在海底睁开眼，像终于回到家。岸上再也等不到那条船。","tradeoff":"船沉了；船员留在海底，长出永久的鳃与蹼，三轮无法入睡。"}]

omen: 空网里传来咀嚼声。
outcomes: [{"id":"net","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"fish.location":"shore","fish.harvested":true,"fisher.can_sleep":false},"goal":{"fish.harvested":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"fisher.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"网里全是鱼，每一条都用他的声音喊饿。","tradeoff":"渔获到手；三轮不得安睡。"},{"id":"gills","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"fisher.gills":true,"fisher.can_act":false,"fish.harvested":false},"goal":{"fish.harvested":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"fisher.can_act":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他终于不饿了。颈侧的鳃正一口口吞下潮水。","tradeoff":"渔获没有恢复；他要用三轮学会这副身体。"}]

omen: 灯罩里的影子没有跟着火动。
outcomes: [{"id":"eyes","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"keeper.beacon":true,"keeper.near_sight":false,"keeper.can_sleep":false,"ship.guided":true},"goal":{"ship.arrived":true},"followup":[{"delay":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"ship.arrived":true}},{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"keeper.beacon":false,"keeper.near_sight":true,"keeper.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"灯灭了。他一闭眼，整片海就亮起来。","tradeoff":"近处视力与睡眠失去三轮。"},{"id":"cloud","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"ship.guided":true,"ship.public_guidance":true,"lamp.functional":false},"goal":{"ship.arrived":true},"followup":[{"delay":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"ship.arrived":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"云底张开一只眼。进港的人都说那是自己的眼睛。","tradeoff":"船靠岸；灯塔仍然坏着。"}]

omen: 船舷上多了一道掌纹。
outcomes: [{"id":"flesh","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"boat.owner":"petitioner","boat.living":true,"boat.ordinary_repair":false,"boat.saleable":false},"goal":{"boat.owner":"petitioner"},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"船板长出主人的指纹。只要他还在，船就会自己愈合。","tradeoff":"船成为活物，不能正常修理或转卖。"},{"id":"abolish","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"boat.owner":"petitioner","boat.hidden":true,"goods.quantity":0},"goal":{"boat.owner":"petitioner"},"followup":[{"delay":2,"requires":{},"updates":{"boat.hidden":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"港务所忘了扣船，船主也忘了装过货。货舱真的空了。","tradeoff":"货物消失；两轮后船重新出现。"}]

omen: 雾里响起了他的声音。
outcomes: [{"id":"inside","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"song.linked":false,"song.pulls":false,"memory.preserved":true,"sailor.can_sleep":false},"goal":{"song.pulls":false},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"sailor.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"歌留在了他脑子里。每个字都亲切，每个停顿都在等他回答。","tradeoff":"不再被诱走；三轮无法入睡。"},{"id":"mouth","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"song.pulls":false,"sailor.mouth_taken":true,"sailor.can_act":false},"goal":{"song.pulls":false},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"sailor.mouth_taken":false,"sailor.can_act":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他开口喊她，回答也从自己的嘴里出来。","tradeoff":"喉咙被占了三轮，无法行动。"}]

omen: 杯里的水在逆着船身倾斜。
outcomes: [{"id":"spring","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"spring.flowing":true,"water.potable":true},"goal":{"water.potable":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"spring.flowing":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"礁石裂开，涌出的水带着人的体温。","tradeoff":"淡水流三轮；疾病还在。"},{"id":"salt","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"water.potable":true,"disease.active":false,"port.open":false},"goal":{"water.potable":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他们喝下海水，没有呕吐。船医却找不到任何人的脉搏。","tradeoff":"病退了，港口仍不准入城。"}]

omen: 根下传来踩雪的声音。
outcomes: [{"id":"walk","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"trees.phase":"dormant","trees.roots_walking":true,"trees.pollination":"dream"},"goal":{"trees.frost_damaged":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"清晨，树都移到了墙的另一边。泥土里只有脚印。","tradeoff":"花保住了；此后只能靠梦授粉。"},{"id":"close","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"trees.phase":"bud","trees.protected":false},"goal":{"trees.frost_damaged":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"花一朵朵缩回枝里，像有人吸回了刚说出口的话。","tradeoff":"花期退回，寒潮仍在。"}]

omen: 磨盘转了一圈，门外少了一声鸟叫。
outcomes: [{"id":"prayers","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"mill.functional":true,"mill.ordinary_power":false,"grain.processed":true,"miller.can_sleep":false},"goal":{"grain.processed":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"miller.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"石磨吐出面粉，磨坊主却每晚听见自己的名字被碾碎。","tradeoff":"粮加工好了；三轮无法入睡，磨坊不再用普通动力。"},{"id":"shard","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"shard.isolated":true,"mill.functional":true,"grain.processed":true},"goal":{"grain.processed":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"黑石自己爬出磨盘。它蹲在门外，一直朝里看。","tradeoff":"这一袋粮磨好了；异物已被隔离。"}]

omen: 钟声变得像一声很长的低鸣。
outcomes: [{"id":"barn","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"herd.location":"home","herd.anomaly_response":false,"herd.bell_response":false},"goal":{"herd.location":"home"},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"牲口回来了，从此再也不听任何铃声。","tradeoff":"它们也忘了牧人的铃。"},{"id":"still","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"herd.boundary_blocked":true,"herd.anomaly_response":false},"goal":{"herd.location":"home"},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"它们在崖边齐齐跪下，把那块石头当成了家。","tradeoff":"不会坠崖，却没有归圈。"}]

omen: 仓门的锁孔里有一排牙。
outcomes: [{"id":"rain","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"grain.quantity":0,"grain.distributed":3,"grain.contested_distribution":true,"door.open":true},"goal":{"grain.distributed":3},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"屋顶张开嘴，三份粮落进人群。没人再听得清账上的名字。","tradeoff":"粮全发了；分配失去秩序。"},{"id":"locked","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"grain.quantity":2,"grain.distributed":1,"manager.protected":false,"clerk.exposed":true},"goal":{"grain.distributed":3},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"仓门只吐出一份粮，随后用记账员的声音喊出了举报者。","tradeoff":"救济只到一份；记账员暴露。"}]

omen: 热气开始往父亲的手上爬。
outcomes: [{"id":"ice","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"condition.active":false,"child.cold_body":true,"child.ordinary_care":false},"goal":{"condition.active":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"她睁开眼，呼出的气结了霜。父亲的掌心却还是烫的。","tradeoff":"高热消退；冷身子永久留下。"},{"id":"father","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"condition.active":false,"parent.can_act":false,"parent.can_sleep":false,"child.recognizes_parent":false},"goal":{"condition.active":false},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"parent.can_act":true,"parent.can_sleep":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"她终于认出了房间里所有东西，唯独指着父亲问：这是谁？","tradeoff":"父亲承受三轮昏沉，孩子忘掉他。"}]

omen: 刀柄里有东西握紧了他。
outcomes: [{"id":"blade","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"hand.injured":false,"hand.blade_fingers":true,"hand.fine_touch":false,"work.completed":true},"goal":{"work.completed":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"指骨钻出皮肤，稳稳刻完最后一笔。","tradeoff":"活做完了，手指再摸不出温度。"},{"id":"still","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"artist.can_act":false,"tool.eye_control":true,"work.completed":true},"goal":{"work.completed":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"artist.can_act":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"手一动不动，刀却自己刻完了。他看着刀，不敢眨眼。","tradeoff":"三轮无法行动；刀替他完成了这次委托。"}]

omen: 他的咳嗽里多了一声石响。
outcomes: [{"id":"breath","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"worker.needs_breath":false,"worker.normal_voice":false,"worker.can_work":true},"goal":{"worker.can_work":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他不再咳，也不再呼吸。井底的灰现在安静地待在他胸口。","tradeoff":"可以工作，永久失去人声。"},{"id":"surface","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"lung.injured":false,"workshop.job_granted":true,"workshop.taught":true,"worker.can_work":true},"goal":{"worker.can_work":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"胸里的白石一粒粒落出来，每粒都带着他的指纹。工坊认出了这门手艺。","tradeoff":"肺伤消退，转到地面工作。"}]

omen: 毯子下面凹下去一块。
outcomes: [{"id":"memory","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"memory.preserved":true,"residue.linked":false,"residue.quiet":true},"goal":{"residue.quiet":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"摇篮停了。她梦见孩子睡得很沉，醒来时掌心还有头发的触感。","tradeoff":"旧梦留下；死者没有回来。"},{"id":"held","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"mother.cradling":true,"mother.can_act":false,"residue.quiet":true},"goal":{"residue.quiet":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"mother.cradling":false,"mother.can_act":true,"residue.linked":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"她抱起了空气。摇篮不动了，她的手臂却怎么也放不下。","tradeoff":"三轮不能外出行动；那不是孩子。"}]

omen: 镜子里的人比他年轻。
outcomes: [{"id":"before","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"memory.accessible":true,"couple.reunited":true,"returned.can_act":false,"returned.borrowed_self":true},"goal":{"memory.accessible":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"returned.can_act":true,"returned.borrowed_self":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他叫出了她年轻时的小名，随即问起了早已死去的人。","tradeoff":"记忆回来；三轮无法参与眼下的生活。"},{"id":"strangers","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"memory.accessible":false,"wish.known":true,"couple.reunited":false},"goal":{"memory.accessible":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他终于说出了心意：记得也好，忘了也好，他不想留下。","tradeoff":"旧记忆没有恢复；他的选择已说清。"}]

omen: 床脚的影子先站了起来。
outcomes: [{"id":"shadow","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"shadow.awake":true,"shadow.providing":true,"carer.providing":true,"daughter.left":true,"daughter.recognized_at_home":false},"goal":{"carer.providing":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"shadow.providing":false,"carer.providing":false,"shadow.awake":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"女儿走了。床脚的影子正在喂饭，母亲叫它女儿。","tradeoff":"三轮照护后影子散去；女儿在家中的位置已被替代。"},{"id":"legs","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"mother.movement_injured":false,"mother.needs_care":false,"daughter.left":true},"goal":{"mother.needs_care":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"母亲站了起来。女儿头也没回地走出门，仿佛早已等过这一幕。","tradeoff":"腿伤治好，女儿离家。"}]

omen: 有人叫他的名字，第二声就忘了。
outcomes: [{"id":"ash","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"receipt.exists":false,"donor.identified":false},"goal":{"donor.identified":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"收据烧成灰，灰里最后剩下的也是一个人名。","tradeoff":"收据被毁，赠粮人未暴露。"},{"id":"missing","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"receipt.masked":true,"donor.identified":false,"donor.can_act":false},"goal":{"donor.identified":false},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"donor.can_act":true}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"家人看着他，像看着一把没坐人的椅子。","tradeoff":"身份藏住了；三轮无法参与任何行动。"}]

omen: 绳圈转向了握绳的那只手。
outcomes: [{"id":"escape","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"accused.location":"shelter","shelter.risk":true},"goal":{"sentence.executed":false},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"绳圈套住了他的影子。他本人已经在避难处醒来。","tradeoff":"人逃走了；判决与追索仍在。"},{"id":"knot","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"executioner.can_execute":false,"executioner.can_act":false,"executioner.neck_knotted":true},"goal":{"sentence.executed":false},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"executioner.can_execute":true,"executioner.can_act":true,"executioner.neck_knotted":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"刽子手摸到自己喉咙里的绳结。台下的人还在等。","tradeoff":"处刑停住；三轮后束缚解除。"}]

omen: 墙后有人在学着用他的声音说话。
outcomes: [{"id":"teeth","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"testimony.received":true,"testimony.public":true,"recipient.teeth_speaking":true,"recipient.can_sleep":false},"goal":{"testimony.received":true},"followup":[{"delay":3,"requires":{},"updates":{"recipient.can_sleep":true,"recipient.teeth_speaking":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"接收者的牙缝吐出了第一句话。接下来的三夜，每次闭眼，审讯都会重来。","tradeoff":"证词传出；接收者三轮无法入睡。"},{"id":"walls","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"testimony.received":true,"testimony.public":true,"prisoner.identified":true},"goal":{"testimony.received":true},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"牢墙的嘴一齐喊出囚徒的名字，然后开始作证。","tradeoff":"街上听见了；囚徒也暴露了。"}]

omen: 纸上的墨正渗向拿信的手。
outcomes: [{"id":"skin","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"letter.exists":false,"confession.exists":true,"confession.submitted":true,"petitioner.office_held":false},"goal":{"letter.owner":"petitioner"},"followup":[],"maintenance":{},"effect":"信烧了，字却从裁判者的皮肤下浮出来。每次出汗都更清楚。","tradeoff":"书信被毁，受贿仍暴露；他失去职位。"},{"id":"blank","weight":1,"requires":{},"updates":{"letter.owner":"petitioner","letter.masked":true},"goal":{"letter.owner":"petitioner"},"followup":[{"delay":2,"requires":{},"updates":{"letter.masked":false}}],"maintenance":{},"effect":"他拿回一封空信。灯一熄，贿赂的字句就从背面渗出来。","tradeoff":"原信到手；两轮后字迹重新出现。"}]
